WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT p.player_name,
           pa.potential,
           c.name AS country_name,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY pa.potential DESC) AS rn
    FROM Player p
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
    JOIN Country c ON pa.player_fifa_api_id = c.id
)
SELECT player_name, potential, country_name
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY country_name, potential DESC;

    SELECT mc.country_id, m.away_player_11
    FROM Match m
    JOIN match_country mc ON m.id = mc.match_id
    WHERE m.away_player_11 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT c.name AS country, AVG(pa.overall_rating) AS average_overall_rating
FROM player_rows pr
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON pr.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
JOIN Country c ON pr.country_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY average_overall_rating DESC;

SELECT AVG(TA.buildUpPlaySpeed) AS average_buildUpPlaySpeed
FROM Team_Attributes TA
JOIN Team T ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "Match" M
    JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id
    JOIN Country C ON L.country_id = C.id
    WHERE C.name = 'Italy'
      AND (M.home_team_api_id = T.team_api_id OR M.away_team_api_id = T.team_api_id)
);

SELECT AVG(ta.buildUpPlaySpeed)
FROM "Team_Attributes" ta
INNER JOIN "Match" m ON ta.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id OR ta.team_api_id = m.away_team_api_id
INNER JOIN "League" l ON m.league_id = l.id
INNER JOIN "Country" c ON l.country_id = c.id
WHERE c.name = 'Italy'

WITH italy_league AS (
  SELECT l.id AS league_id
  FROM "League" l
  JOIN "Country" c ON l.country_id = c.id
  WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
),
italy_teams AS (
  SELECT home_team_api_id AS team_api_id
  FROM "Match"
  WHERE league_id = (SELECT league_id FROM italy_league)
  UNION
  SELECT away_team_api_id
  FROM "Match"
  WHERE league_id = (SELECT league_id FROM italy_league)
)
SELECT AVG(ta."buildUpPlaySpeed") AS average_buildUpPlaySpeed
FROM "Team_Attributes" ta
JOIN italy_teams it ON ta.team_api_id = it.team_api_id;

WITH caps AS (
    SELECT m.home_team_api_id AS team_api_id, m.home_player_1 AS player_api_id
    FROM "Match" m
    UNION ALL
    SELECT m.away_team_api_id, m.away_player_1
    FROM "Match" m
),
cap_counts AS (
    SELECT team_api_id, player_api_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM caps
    GROUP BY team_api_id, player_api_id
),
max_counts AS (
    SELECT team_api_id, MAX(cnt) AS max_cnt
    FROM cap_counts
    GROUP BY team_api_id
)
SELECT t.team_long_name, p.player_name
FROM cap_counts cc
JOIN max_counts mc
    ON cc.team_api_id = mc.team_api_id AND cc.cnt = mc.max_cnt
JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = cc.team_api_id
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = cc.player_api_id;
